Record Class ContainerDetail

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
global.thalion.ttio.workbench.containers.ContainerDetail
public record ContainerDetail(String uri, String project, String owner, boolean encrypted, String storagePath, long createdAt, long updatedAt, long sizeBytes, long modifiedAt) extends Record
Per-container detail row as returned by GET /v1/containers/{uri}. Adds on-disk metadata (sizeBytes() and modifiedAt()) on top of the fields surfaced by the list endpoint.

Cross-language equivalent: Python ttio.workbench.containers.ContainerDetail.
